worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.summary: Slide low along the ground and slam the target with your body: contact damage and a shove, and the landing presses a small stand of grass into the ground. On Grassy Terrain the grass lifts you, so the preparation drops to zero and the slide goes further and faster - that is the native 'always goes first'. The seeding form grows a much larger, longer patch at the cost of a shorter slide.
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.use.0: Fire an instant first-strike slam while standing on grass
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.use.1: Close in and slide through, shoving the target
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.use.2: Seed a stand of grass at the landing for yourself and allies
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.descriptio: The slam deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Slide up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; it strikes only the first non-ally on the path, shoving a landed target about %3$s blocks, and comes up empty if no one blocks the way.
A landed slam presses a grassy field of radius %1$s blocks into the ground where the target lands, lasting %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.seed.on: Seeding form: the landing grows a much larger, longer stand of grass that makes your glide instant while you stand on it, at 0.85 slide distance, x0.92 per hit, 2 ticks more recovery and 8 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.seed.off: Sprinting form: a longer slide that recovers sooner, pressing only a small brief patch of grass.
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation (zero on Grassy Terrain), %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.growth.0: At level %1$s the slam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.growth.1: At level %1$s the slam rises to %2$s and the slide to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.preference: On: the landing grows a much larger, longer stand of grass that counts as Grassy Terrain (stronger Grass moves, and your glide is instant while you stand on it), at 0.85 slide distance, x0.92 per hit, 2 ticks more recovery and 8 ticks more cooldown. Off: a longer slide that recovers sooner and leaves only a small patch.
It only opens at targets within this distance; the move is short-ranged, so a larger value lets it commit sooner.
On: a low-health target ranks higher so an instant first-strike slam can finish it. Off: every target ranks the same.
On: while standing on Grassy Terrain, this move ranks higher (zero preparation, more reach and speed). Off: rank it as an ordinary melee candidate.
world_combat.move.grassyglide.text.plant: A stand of grass is pressed in
worldcombat.skill.grassyglide.descriptio: That grass treats both sides alike: a grounded body standing on it counts as being on Grassy Terrain — Grass moves deal x1.3, its own Earthquake and Bulldoze are halved, and Grassy Glide needs no preparation and slides further and faster. Airborne bodies do not count, and the grass withers when it expires.
